name: source-path-rows
goal: Source paths and code actions fit one desktop line and at most two mobile lines

evidence: Desktop path and code action must share one line; mobile allows two. Folder text may truncate; filename and original link remain.

Existing entity-preview-source matrix verified links, modal and compact actions but not path wrapping or row height. Strengthened its shared fileLink check for no wrapping, full title and responsive row bound.
